entries.german:
Beschwerde Albrechts von Rosenberg gegen die Schwäbischen Bundesverwandten und Kurpfalz wegen des seinem Vater im Jahre 1523 gewaltsam entzogenen Stammgutes Boxberg

Laufzeit: 1544

Enthält: Darin: Druckschrift: "Warhaffter Bericht uß was ursach der edel und vest Albrecht von Rosenberg etc. die kaiserlichen gegenweer gegen den gewesen eilffjärigen Schwebischen Pundsstenden gebrauchen und fürnemmen müssen"
entries.english:
Complaint of Albrecht von Rosenberg against the former members of the Swabian League and the Palatinate over the family estate of Boxberg, which had been taken by force from his father in 1523

Period: 1544

Contains: Including: Printed pamphlet: 'True Report on what grounds the noble and resolute Albrecht von Rosenberg etc. had to use and intended to use imperial defense against the former eleven-year Swabian League estates'

facts.content: complained against the former members of the Swabian League and the Palatinate over the family estate of Boxberg, which had been taken by force from his father in 1523.
